data.prompt:
Review moderation activity in Discord guild GUILD_ID for the past week.

1. Call discord_get_audit_log with guild_id = GUILD_ID and limit = 100 to fetch recent audit-log entries.
2. Group the entries by action_type and summarize what happened: members kicked (action_type 20), banned (22) or unbanned (23), roles created/updated/deleted, channels created (10)/deleted (12), and any timeouts (member updates with communication_disabled_until).
3. For each notable action, note the actor (user_id in the entry) and the target.

Produce a concise summary like:
**Weekly Moderation Summary — <server name>**
_Period: <start> to <end>_

• Bans: N (list notable ones)
• Kicks: N
• Timeouts: N
• Role changes: N
• Channel changes: N

If there was no moderation activity, say so briefly.

IMPORTANT: Replace GUILD_ID with the actual guild id before using this flow. This flow only READS the audit log; it does not modify the server.
